shared_elements: linear script signs incised on a stone surface
enclosed or framed text areas (border lines / cartouche-like enclosures)
justification: Both surfaces are covered chiefly by inscription: rows of incised script signs organised into lines, with linear framing (a ruled border on A, oval enclosures and register lines on B). But A shows only abstract angular stick-like characters with no figural imagery, whereas B combines pictographic signs (birds, human/animal forms, discs) with a large relief figure in profile, so the sign repertoire, the presence of imagery and the layout conventions are quite different.
